propositions: reconciler core modules pass transport parameters without type annotations or with Any, preventing mypy from enforcing that implementations declare required members
port type imports via rebar_reconciler.* shim path are widened to Any by ignore_missing_imports, rendering annotations silently blind even when syntactically present
relative imports within rebar._engine.rebar_reconciler restore mypy's ability to resolve and enforce TicketTransport as the annotated type

capability members (add_comment, set_relationship, get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map) carried as metaclass attributes are invisible to mypy's Protocol checking, requiring narrowing to composed capability views at call sites
